This question asks whether the daily average temperature at Troyes-Barberey Airport will be higher on November 2, 2025 than on October 26, 2025. The forecast date is October 16, 2025, giving us a 17-day lead time for the first comparison date and a 10-day lead time for the second.

In early November in northeastern France (Troyes is in the Champagne region), temperatures typically decline as winter approaches. October 26 is still in autumn with relatively milder conditions, while November 2 is transitioning into late autumn with generally cooler temperatures.

Historically, daily temperatures in this region show a clear seasonal trend downward from late October to early November. The probability of a reversal (November 2 being warmer than October 26) would require an unusual weather pattern.

Given the typical seasonal cooling pattern and the 7-day gap between the dates, I estimate a below-50% probability that November 2 will be warmer than October 26.
